b: The Passion Awakens, Infected by Art Volume 14 cover art by Lisa L Cyr

Navigating the twisted labyrinth of the creative mind, I journey inside myself to the world of the fantastic: a sacred place where dreams and nightmares come to call. A gateway to the inner sanctuary, the adventurous quest establishes a theatrical stage from which the paradoxical, mystical realms of the subconscious mind present themselves.

“Throughout my work, portals within the subconscious mind reveal an inner journey to transcendental otherworldly places where metaphor, symbolism and allegory awaken my imaginative faculties.” – Lisa L Cyr

The mixed-media painting entitled The Passion Awakens is part of a series of works from my artistic endeavor entitled “Figure of the Imagination: An Artist’s Journey.” The multi-media project encompasses a diverse array of story-driven works, from visual journals, sketchbooks and hybrid storytelling to multi-dimensional paintings and sculptural works with inspirational music and sound elements. The multi-media project will be featured in an upcoming book project called Figure of the Imagination: An Artist’s Journey. I hope to someday have a major traveling exhibition of the work as a whole.

To take others on the artistic adventure with me, I have created Navigating the Labyrinth of the Creative Mind as a transformative online atelier designed for artists who are ready to take ownership of their creative journey, ultimately finding their unique voice and vision.
The Passion Awakens by Lisa L Cyr 48″ x 48” x 2 1/8″ mixed media on assembled cradled panels
“Like a burst of light that illuminates the universe, we hold within us a divine spark: a desire to connect to something bigger than ourselves.” – Lisa L Cyr
The Passion Awakens portrait details by Lisa L Cyr

It’s a time of immense change. Uncertainty abounds and we are all embarking onto uncharted territory. The use of fantastical art and imaginative storytelling can be used as a vehicle for self-expression to inspire, uplift and heal the universal consciousness.
The Passion Awakens detail by Lisa L Cyr
“With every act of play, I am intrigued as to where the work will lead me. With every attempt at the easel, I become an active witness to my own journey.” – Lisa L Cyr ​​

Through our creative endeavors, we pass on a divine spark, inspiring others to awaken the passion within. Art is infectious. It creates ripples in its wake. As artists, our work is a catalyst: a force of positive transformation that can spread far and wide throughout the culture.
Infected by Art Volume 14 back cover, The Story of Transformation, by sculptor Liuyazi (Arya) Hou

For what else is the ultimate purpose of art? Author Leo Tolstoy has said it best when he conveys the impetus for creative endeavors as an involuntary transmission of emotions and ideas from the soul of an artist to be experienced by an onlooker. In his 1897 essay called What is Art?, The author refers to art as a direct bridge of emotional infection between human beings, where an artist experiences a connection with the work, intentionally infecting the audience through his or her unique artistic expression.
“Imaginative artistic expression creates moments of awe and a profound belief that there is something bigger and more worthwhile in the world to experience.” – Lisa L Cyr

At the 2026 IX Art Show, the Infected by Art booth was a welcoming destination for attendees, as it displayed the newest juried volumes of Infected by Art Volume 14, showcasing the absolute best in contemporary fantasy, horror, sci-fi and imaginative realism from digital and traditional artists around the world.
The Fourteenth annual of Infected by Art was juried by an impressive group of judges: Kai Carpenter, Sean Andrew Murray, Ornelie Sculpture, Matthew Stawicki and John Tedrick.
Infected by Art’s team Todd Spoor and Bill Cox at the 2026 IX Art Show held on October 21-25, 2026 at the GoggleWorks Center for the Arts in Reading , PA

Artist and collectors visited the booth just to flip through the massive collections, purchased limited convention-exclusive editions and viewed some of the stunning award-winning art created by the world’s leading artists in the fantasy, science fiction, horror and imaginative realism genres. The 14th annual of Infected by Art is an impressive collection of over three-hundred pieces of imaginative realism art, representing a broad range of styles and media. I am very honored to have been chosen to be the cover artist for Infected by Art volume 14.

“One of the greatest feelings Bill and I have is the appreciation that we receive from the artistic community. Infected by Art (IBA) is a labor of love for us. We feel really proud to be carrying the torch, giving artists a venue to show their incredible work.” – Todd Spoor

This year, there is also a Kickstarter campaign. Through this exclusive campaign, Infected by Art volume 14 is being presold in both print and digital editions.
